name: Eloqua
description: Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation is an enterprise platform for campaigns, contacts, emails, forms, lead scoring, segmentation, and marketing measurement. Organizations use it to design and operate cross-channel B2B marketing programs.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Eloqua site through a customer-owned AppCloud OAuth app and a dedicated least-privilege user. Eloqua exposes only a non-granular full OAuth scope, so Relay compensates by site and pod binding, fixed selected-resource paths, minimal depth, and redacted projections for one contact and one campaign; all broader access and mutations are blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: ELOQUA_SITE_NAME
credentialRequirements.label: Eloqua site name
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact Eloqua site/company name; Relay verifies it against the authenticated /id response before using the discovered pod.

credentialRequirements.name: ELOQUA_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Eloqua AppCloud app client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-owned AppCloud app configured with Relay's exact callback URL.

credentialRequirements.name: ELOQUA_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Eloqua AppCloud app client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay encrypts this customer secret and sends it only to login.eloqua.com.

credentialRequirements.name: ELOQUA_REFRESH_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Eloqua OAuth refresh token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-owned app refresh grant for a dedicated least-privilege Eloqua user.

credentialRequirements.name: ELOQUA_CONTACT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected contact ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one contact whose ID and timestamps Relay may read.

credentialRequirements.name: ELOQUA_CAMPAIGN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected campaign ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one campaign whose bounded summary Relay may read.

capabilities.label: Read selected contact summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and timestamps for one selected contact without identity, address, activity, preference, score, account, or custom fields.

capabilities.label: Read selected campaign summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded organizational metadata for one selected campaign.

allowed.label: Read selected contact summary
allowed.description: Read the selected contact's ID and timestamps at minimal depth while discarding all personal and marketing fields.

allowed.label: Read selected campaign summary
allowed.description: Read the selected campaign's ID, name, current status, and timestamps at minimal depth while discarding costs, folders, users, elements, fields, and related assets.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Contact identity, address, preference, activity, account, custom, scoring, and field values plus campaign descriptions, costs, users, elements, fields, and raw responses are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Eloqua state
blocked.description: Contact changes, campaigns, sends, forms, emails, assets, imports, exports, administration, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Eloqua access
blocked.description: Other sites, contacts, campaigns, pods, assets, lists, searches, pages, depths, Bulk API, arbitrary paths, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked despite Eloqua's non-granular full OAuth scope.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected contact and campaign through a site-bound customer OAuth grant; private data, broader access, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway refreshes encrypted customer-owned Eloqua OAuth credentials server-side and mounts exactly two site-bound projected reads.
Railway refreshes encrypted customer-owned Eloqua OAuth credentials server-side and mounts exactly two site-bound projected reads.

providerSetup.blocker: An Eloqua subscription, dedicated least-privilege user with Advanced Users - Marketing access for pod discovery, customer-owned AppCloud OAuth app, refresh grant, exact site name, and staging contact/campaign IDs are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Eloqua administrator must create a customer-owned AppCloud app with the exact Railway callback, grant a dedicated staging user only the minimum site permissions required for /id and the two selected reads, capture the full-scope refresh grant in the provider-console lane, connect the exact site/resource IDs, then validate site/pod binding, both projections, LBAC and insufficient-permission denial, refresh, revocation by app removal, replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Oracle documents Basic and OAuth 2.0 authentication and recommends OAuth 2.0 for Eloqua REST APIs.
Oracle documents customer AppCloud app registration, authorization-code and refresh-token exchange at login.eloqua.com, HTTP Basic client authentication, and Eloqua's non-granular full OAuth scope.
Oracle documents authenticated /id discovery, returned site identity and pod-specific REST origins, caching, site moves, and the Advanced Users - Marketing minimum permission.
Oracle documents selected-contact retrieval and minimal request depth; Relay projects only ID and timestamps from the response.
Oracle documents selected-campaign retrieval, minimal request depth, and the campaign metadata used for Relay's bounded projection.
Oracle documents Eloqua authentication, authorization, validation, not-found, rate-limit, and availability status codes used for safe error mapping.
